posts.name: Neeraj Lilani
posts.cooked:
Problem Statement:
The current address field in forms like Sales Invoices or Purchase Orders requires linking to a full address list, which can be cumbersome for simple entries. In my UAE-based wholesale business, we often need quick, manual address input without navigating a separate list, but we still want the option for structured addresses when dealing with multiple locations.

Proposed Feature:
Add a setup option or system setting to enable a “simple” address field (e.g., a single text area for free-form entry). Include a toggle in Settings > Customize Form or during initial setup to switch to the full “Address List” mode if needed. This could be per-module or global.

Benefits/Use Case:
This would speed up data entry for small businesses or quick transactions, reducing clicks while maintaining flexibility for complex setups. For example, in retail operations like mine, it saves time on one-off customer addresses without losing the ability to use structured lists for repeat clients.
